主要内容: Commercial National Financial Corporation reported Q1 2013 results, showing net income of $1.1 million, down from $3.8 million in Q1 2012. Earnings per share were $0.39, compared to $1.33 in the prior year. Total assets rose to $377.7 million from $373.1 million. Net interest income decreased to $3.3 million from $4.2 million. The company maintained strong capital ratios: Tier 1 risk-based capital at 22.65%, total risk-based capital at 23.43%, and leverage capital at 12.88%. Loan portfolio credit quality remained high, with no loan loss provisioning needed over the past 17 quarters. The company's core earnings outperformed banking industry norms, supporting a regular $0.26 quarterly dividend. The company operates ten community banking facilities in Pennsylvania and an asset management and trust division headquartered in Greensburg, Pennsylvania, with additional services through an Internet banking site and an automated TouchTone Teller banking system.
